claude.performance_metric: complete liquidation/dissolution; liquidating distributions $4,327.5M (2020) and $4,514.6M (2021); net assets $3,470,092K at 12/31/2021
claude.rationale: The realized record documents an orderly court-supervised complete liquidation and dissolution: the registrant "sold, distributed or otherwise disposed of substantially all of its remaining non-cash assets," monetized its former Alibaba and Yahoo Japan minority stakes, and returned capital via successive liquidating distributions. No product/process integration disruption is documented (there was no operating product line to align, and the slice shows only orderly monetization and wind-down), so p4_pathway = 0. Likewise no process/organization fracture (operations vs people/culture breaking down) is documented; the entity acted as an investment vehicle executing an approved dissolution plan, so p5_pathway = 0. The slice contains no information about the controlling-intent archetype or the reconciliation of two business models, so t1 and t2 are uncertain.

grok.rationale: The slice documents only a court-supervised complete liquidation and wind-down of Altaba as a closed-end investment company, with monetization of remaining Alibaba/Yahoo Japan holdings into short-term fixed-income securities and successive liquidating distributions to shareholders; no product/process interface disruption is described. Likewise, no process/organization fracture (operations vs. people/management/culture) is documented—activities are limited to winding up affairs and retaining IRS claim reserves under a Delaware Section 280 proceeding.

openai.rationale: The registrant disposed of substantially all remaining non-cash assets and limited its activities to winding up its affairs, but the slice documents no realized product/process alignment disruption. It also reports dissolution, asset monetization, reserves for claims, and liquidating distributions without documenting any breakdown between operations and people, management, or culture.
